description.content: A [Workflow](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683108756-Create-a-new-Workflow) is a combination of Steps, Paths, Fields, and routing logic that combine to form a system in an Application

**Permissions:** [Build Access](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683190164-Control-Build-Access-for-Applications)

Retrieve a page of all workflows that the current user has [Build Access to parent application](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683190164-Control-Build-Access-for-Applications) to.

query.description: The unique ID of a parent application where, if provided, the response will only contain workflows from the identified application
Whether [Jira workflows](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us) are to be included in the response in addition to regular workflows (defaults to true)
The zero-indexed page number (must not be less than 0, defaults to 0)
The size of the page and maximum number of items to be returned (must not be less than 1, defaults to 20)

description.content:
Welcome to the Risk Cloud API v2! This is a collection of new API-first and RESTful API endpoints to streamline the creation of custom integrations with the Risk Cloud.

For the API documentation of our legacy API v1 endpoints, reference [Risk Cloud API v1](https://docs.logicgate.com/v1/index.html).
